<div class="card-body">
'''Darth Vader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] from [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダース・ベイダー</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘の際、各戦闘運命数を＋1できる（合計に＋1ではなく、1回引くごとに＋1できる）。彼が操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋3となる。「ベイダー専用タイ・ファイター」に乗っているなら、戦闘力＋4、回避値＋3となる。耐：損耗＜5。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">シスの暗黒卿。皇帝の僕。サイバネティック生命維持装置を内蔵した装甲服に身を包む。オビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子であった。銀河一のパイロットであり、狡猾な戦士でもある。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Darth Vader.

'''Lore:''' Dark Lord of the Sith. Servant of the Emperor. Clad in armor containing a cybernetic life-support system. Was a pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi. The best pilot in the galaxy and also a cunning warrior.

'''Game text:''' During battle, you may add 1 to each battle destiny number (not 1 to the total, but 1 for each draw). A starship he pilots has power +3. If aboard Vader's Custom TIE, it has power +4 and maneuver +3. Immune to attrition < 5.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text explicitly explains that the bonus applies to each draw rather than the total; the English printed text says it adds 1 to each battle destiny. The Japanese uses 'pilot' where the English lore says 'starpilot.' The conditional wording also says he may add the bonus.
<h2>Notes</h2>
'''Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Darth Vader]], released by [[Decipher]] as a case topper for [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] in January 2001.<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 21. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> Its checklist rarity is P.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>



Each case of six Reflections II booster boxes included one Japanese Darth Vader foil as a case topper. Each box also included one randomly selected foil box topper: [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]], [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]], [[Leia With Blaster Rifle]] or [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]].<ref name="topper-distribution">[https://store.starwarsccg.org/product/reflections-2-complete-foil-set-105-foils/ Reflections 2 Complete Foil Set], Star Wars CCG Players Committee Store. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210412121344/https://store.starwarsccg.org/product/reflections-2-complete-foil-set-105-foils/ Internet Archive].</ref>
